The Sooners were led by [[Lon Kruger]] in his second season. The team played its home games at the [[Lloyd Noble Center]] in [[Norman, Oklahoma|Norman]], [[Oklahoma]] as a member of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. They finished the season 20–12, 11–7 in Big 12 play to finish in a tie for fourth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2013 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to Iowa State. The received an at-large bid to the [[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2013 NCAA tournament]], where they lost in the second round to San Diego State. ==Preseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
